parameters.query: SELECT id, name FROM architecture.projects WHERE slug = $1 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (type) type, content FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type IN ('infrastructure_arch','application_arch','data_arch','solution_arch_md') ORDER BY type, version DESC

WITH params AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb AS p),
     v AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 AS next_version FROM architecture.artifacts, params WHERE project_id=(SELECT (p->>'projectId')::uuid FROM params) AND type='oam_application')
INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta)
SELECT (p->>'projectId')::uuid, 'oam_application', v.next_version, p->'content', md5((p->'content')::text), p->'meta'
FROM params, v
RETURNING version, created_at
